answer: A reef challenge chain blocks bulk fakes. Each agent locks 70 credits and files one key-signed copper link per epoch to the reef ledger; each link hashes the prior reading under an ivory tag, so it only grows forward. An auditor replays the chain; a skip, copy, or fork burns the bond. First 38, k-th 38+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 4,034,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented links fail: bought links hash another key's past. An honest agent pays 38 once.
